text:
Arriving at Hakata Station in Fukuoka?
It has two sides, a ramen floor and a rooftop shrine.
5 things to know before your train pulls in 👇

1️⃣ Two exits, two worlds
The Hakata exit faces the city and the bus terminal.
Canal City is about 10 minutes on foot.
The Chikushi side is quieter, with business hotels.

2️⃣ The airport is underground
The subway Airport Line takes about 5 minutes.
Two stops, ¥260. No need to go outside.

3️⃣ A whole floor of ramen
Hakata Men Kaido is on DEITOS 2F,
next to the Shinkansen gates, open as late as 23:30.

4️⃣ Compare mentaiko before you buy
In Hakata Hankyu's food hall (B1),
the big mentaiko makers sit side by side.

5️⃣ Send your bags ahead
Multi E-Cube lockers deliver to Fukuoka hotels
the same day: book by 9:30, drop by 11:00.

✨ Bonus: a railway shrine on the roof
In JR Hakata City's rooftop garden, about 60 m up.
Open 10:00–22:00.
